name: hiverunner

scripts.qa:stress:software: NODE_ENV=development PORT=3010 MC_DEV_EXECUTION_TEST_MODE=1 MC_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS=1000 MC_TICK_MAX_CONCURRENT=6 MC_DATA_DIR=$PWD/data-dev MC_WORKSPACE_ROOT=$HOME/.hiverunner/dev/workspaces node ./scripts/run-tsx.mjs scripts/qa/hiverunner-software-stress.ts
scripts.test:auth: npm run test:auth-mode && npm run test:auth-local-single-user-middleware && npm run test:auth-local-dev-session-route && npm run test:auth-legacy-cookie-routes && npm run test:auth-cookie-bypass && npm run test:auth-signup-route && npm run test:auth-orchestration-local-guard && npm run test:auth-localhost-bypass && npm run test:auth-hosted-fail-closed
scripts.fallow:report: mkdir -p output/fallow && npm --silent run fallow -- health --report-only --format markdown > output/fallow/fallow-health.md && npm --silent run fallow -- dead-code --format markdown > output/fallow/fallow-dead-code.md && npm --silent run fallow -- dupes --format markdown > output/fallow/fallow-dupes.md && npm --silent run fallow -- audit --base origin/main --format markdown > output/fallow/fallow-audit.md

description: Local-first command center for running AI agent teams.
